name: Match
description: The submitted value matched the reference used by the verification service

name: No Match
description: The submitted value did not match the reference used by the verification service

name: Not Applicable
description: The verification check did not apply to this transaction or credential

name: Not Provided
description: A value was not supplied for verification

name: Not Supported
description: The verification service or source did not support the check

name: Not Verified
description: A conclusive verification result was not produced

name: Partial Match
description: Only part of the submitted value matched the reference used by the verification service

name: Skipped
description: The verification check was intentionally not attempted

name: System Error
description: The verification check could not complete because of a system or communication error

name: Unknown
description: The raw result was missing or had no known normalized outcome
